Eight Devotees Die After Car Swept Away in Flooded Drain in MP

Eight devotees returning from a visit to the Maa Baglamukhi temple in Nalkheda, Agar Malwa district, Madhya Pradesh, died when their car was swept away in a swollen monsoon drain. The deceased included three children, two women, and three men, all reportedly from Odisha. The incident occurred after heavy rainfall caused the drain to overflow.
